nodes.name: Performing Arts
nodes.description: Art forms enacted live before an audience, including theater, dance, opera, and performance art.

nodes.name: Theater
nodes.description: The live enactment of dramatic narratives through acting, speech, and staging.

nodes.name: Tragedy
nodes.description: Drama depicting the downfall of a protagonist through fate or flaw.

nodes.name: Comedy
nodes.description: Drama aiming to provoke laughter, often ending happily.

nodes.name: Tragicomedy
nodes.description: Drama blending tragic and comic elements.

nodes.name: Farce
nodes.description: Broad physical comedy of absurd situations and exaggeration.

nodes.name: Melodrama
nodes.description: Sensational drama of heightened emotion and clear moral polarity.

nodes.name: Greek Theatre
nodes.description: Ancient Athenian drama of tragedy, comedy, and satyr plays in open amphitheaters.

nodes.name: Roman Theatre
nodes.description: Ancient Roman drama adapted from Greek models with spectacle and farce.

nodes.name: Medieval Theatre
nodes.description: Religious mystery, miracle, and morality plays of medieval Europe.

nodes.name: Commedia dell'Arte
nodes.description: Italian improvised masked comedy of stock characters.

nodes.name: Elizabethan Theatre
nodes.description: English Renaissance drama of Shakespeare and contemporaries.

nodes.name: Restoration Comedy
nodes.description: Witty, satirical English comedy of the late 17th century.

nodes.name: Realism in Theater
nodes.description: Late 19th-century theater staging everyday life with psychological truth.

nodes.name: Epic Theatre
nodes.description: Brechtian theater using alienation effects to provoke critical reflection.

nodes.name: Theatre of the Absurd
nodes.description: Postwar drama expressing existential meaninglessness through illogical dialogue.

nodes.name: Physical Theatre
nodes.description: Theater prioritizing bodily movement and gesture over text.

nodes.name: Immersive Theatre
nodes.description: Theater in which audiences move through and participate in the performance space.

nodes.name: Improvisational Theatre
nodes.description: Theater created spontaneously without a script.

nodes.name: Verbatim Theatre
nodes.description: Documentary theater built from the exact words of interviews and records.

nodes.name: Site-Specific Theatre
nodes.description: Theater staged in locations chosen for their meaning to the work.

nodes.name: Mime
nodes.description: Wordless performance conveying meaning through gesture and movement.

nodes.name: Japanese Theatre
nodes.description: The classical theater traditions of Japan.

nodes.name: Noh
nodes.description: Austere masked Japanese musical drama of the samurai era, with slow stylized movement.

nodes.name: Kabuki
nodes.description: Vivid popular Japanese theater of stylized acting, elaborate makeup, and spectacle.

nodes.name: Kyogen
nodes.description: Comic interludes performed between Noh plays.

nodes.name: Chinese Opera
nodes.description: Chinese sung theater combining music, stylized movement, costume, and acrobatics.

nodes.name: Peking Opera
nodes.description: Beijing opera combining song, speech, dance, and martial arts in stylized roles.

nodes.name: Kunqu
nodes.description: The refined classical Chinese opera of Suzhou, a UNESCO intangible heritage.

nodes.name: Yue Opera
nodes.description: Popular all-female Chinese opera of Zhejiang origin.

nodes.name: Dance
nodes.description: Art of expressive movement of the body, usually to music or rhythm.

nodes.name: Choreography
nodes.description: The art of designing and arranging dance movement.

nodes.name: Ballet
nodes.description: Codified classical dance technique developed in European courts.

nodes.name: Classical Ballet
nodes.description: Ballet following strict technique, pointe work, and narrative tradition.

nodes.name: Romantic Ballet
nodes.description: 19th-century ballet emphasizing ethereal female dancers and supernatural themes.

nodes.name: Neoclassical Ballet
nodes.description: 20th-century ballet stripping narrative for pure movement and speed.

nodes.name: Contemporary Ballet
nodes.description: Ballet blending classical technique with modern and contemporary movement.

nodes.name: Modern Dance
nodes.description: Early 20th-century dance rejecting ballet's strictures for expression and natural movement.

nodes.name: Contemporary Dance
nodes.description: Postmodern dance merging techniques and improvisation from the mid-20th century.

nodes.name: Jazz Dance
nodes.description: Energetic dance rooted in African-American vernacular movement and jazz music.

nodes.name: Tap Dance
nodes.description: Percussive dance producing rhythm with metal-plated shoes.

nodes.name: Hip-Hop Dance
nodes.description: Street dance styles emerging from hip-hop culture.

nodes.name: Breaking
nodes.description: Acrobatic hip-hop dance of floorwork, freezes, and power moves.

nodes.name: Popping
nodes.description: Funk dance of sharp muscle contractions to the beat.

nodes.name: Locking
nodes.description: Funk dance of freeze-and-unfreeze movements and comedic flair.

nodes.name: Ballroom Dance
nodes.description: Partner dances performed socially and competitively.

nodes.name: Waltz
nodes.description: Smooth triple-time partner dance originating in Central Europe.

nodes.name: Tango Dance
nodes.description: Close embrace partner dance of Argentina and Uruguay.

nodes.name: Folk Dance
nodes.description: Traditional community dances expressing regional and ethnic identity.

nodes.name: Irish Dance
nodes.description: Rhythmic step dance of Ireland, famed for stiff upper body and fast footwork.

nodes.name: Flamenco Dance
nodes.description: Passionate Andalusian dance of percussive footwork and expressive arms.

nodes.name: Kathak
nodes.description: North Indian classical dance of rhythmic footwork and storytelling.

nodes.name: Indian Classical Dance
nodes.description: The codified classical dance traditions of India, grounded in Natya Shastra.

nodes.name: Bharatanatyam
nodes.description: Tamil classical dance of sculpture-like poses and expressive gesture.

nodes.name: Odissi
nodes.description: Classical dance of Odisha known for its tribhangi curved posture.

nodes.name: Kathakali
nodes.description: Kerala dance-drama of elaborate makeup, gesture, and epic storytelling.

nodes.name: Kuchipudi
nodes.description: Classical dance-drama of Andhra Pradesh blending dance and acting.

nodes.name: Mohiniyattam
nodes.description: Graceful feminine classical dance of Kerala.

nodes.name: Butoh
nodes.description: Japanese avant-garde dance of slow, grotesque transformation born postwar.

nodes.name: Opera
nodes.description: Dramatic art form in which singers and orchestra enact a story through music.

nodes.name: Opera Seria
nodes.description: 18th-century serious Italian opera of noble characters and da capo arias.

nodes.name: Opera Buffa
nodes.description: Comic Italian opera of everyday characters and ensemble finales.

nodes.name: Grand Opera
nodes.description: 19th-century French opera of large-scale spectacle and chorus.

nodes.name: Verismo
nodes.description: Late 19th-century Italian opera of realistic, often violent everyday drama.

nodes.name: Music Drama
nodes.description: Wagner's operatic ideal unifying music, text, and staging in continuous drama.

nodes.name: Operetta
nodes.description: Light opera with spoken dialogue and popular song.

nodes.name: Zarzuela
nodes.description: Spanish lyric drama alternating song and spoken dialogue.

nodes.name: Chamber Opera
nodes.description: Opera for small casts and ensembles.

nodes.name: Musical Theatre
nodes.description: Theatrical entertainment combining songs, dialogue, acting, and dance.

nodes.name: Book Musical
nodes.description: Musical with an integrated plot in which songs advance the story.

nodes.name: Jukebox Musical
nodes.description: Musical built around pre-existing popular songs.

nodes.name: Rock Musical
nodes.description: Musical using rock music styles and instrumentation.

nodes.name: Performance Art
nodes.description: Art in which the artist's live actions are the medium.

nodes.name: Happening
nodes.description: Improvised, participatory events of the 1950s-60s blurring art and life.

nodes.name: Body Art
nodes.description: Art using the artist's body as canvas and medium.

nodes.name: Endurance Art
nodes.description: Performance art testing the artist's physical or psychological limits over time.

nodes.name: Live Art
nodes.description: Contemporary interdisciplinary live performance practice.

nodes.name: Circus Arts
nodes.description: Entertainment of skilled physical feats, clowning, and spectacle.

nodes.name: Acrobatics
nodes.description: Feats of balance, agility, and coordination of the human body.

nodes.name: Juggling
nodes.description: Manipulating multiple objects in the air.

nodes.name: Clowning
nodes.description: Comic performance through exaggerated character and physical comedy.

nodes.name: Aerial Silks
nodes.description: Acrobatics performed suspended on fabric.

nodes.name: Trapeze
nodes.description: Aerial acrobatics on a swinging horizontal bar.

nodes.name: Puppetry
nodes.description: The art of animating inanimate figures in performance.

nodes.name: Shadow Puppetry
nodes.description: Puppetry projecting silhouettes onto a screen.

nodes.name: Wayang Kulit
nodes.description: Indonesian shadow puppetry of leather figures enacting epics.

nodes.name: Marionette
nodes.description: Puppets manipulated from above by strings.

nodes.name: Hand Puppet
nodes.description: Puppets worn on the hand and manipulated by fingers.

nodes.name: Bunraku
nodes.description: Japanese puppet theater with large puppets and chanting narrators.
